title: Pair scoring — left hand result retained

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: REVISED 3D game-show art-direction concept for VIGINTI, landscape16:10. Use the reference's simplified orange/turquoise/cream cartoon physical table, restrained small cardboard sun host, plain theatrical background and prominent top score fascia. This is CONCEPT ART FOR AN ACTUAL THREE.JS 3D GAME, not an HTML interface, dashboard, wireframe or flat website.
The previous central shared hand ledger was rejected. ABSOLUTE DESIGN REQUIREMENT: ALL THREE HANDS OWN THEIR OWN PERSISTENT SCORING BREAKDOWNS, physically attached to their card bay. A player must be able to look at each hand and immediately read its cards, blackjack total, scoring rows and accumulated cash/mult contribution together. NEVER place one central ledger detached from the hand. NEVER erase a previous hand's scoring when the next hand starts. The final frame must show all three histories simultaneously.
Make the table THREE clear continuous cream scoring lanes/podiums across left, centre and right, each containing the hand's own cards in its near/front half and a compact rake of local score strips rising from the far/back edge of THAT SAME HAND BAY. The strips and card mat form one visibly connected physical assembly, not free-floating UI elsewhere. A subtle horizontal cash/mult contribution strip belongs to the SAME lane. Keep lane X positions fixed. Leave enough space vertically: the hand breakdowns occupy middle-height of the view, cards below, blackjack numbers directly below the cards. The cards can rise locally in 3D during scoring, but must not cover their scoring strips or neighbouring results.
Each local scoring rack has columns REASON / CASH / +MULT. Cash and multiplier are contributions, NOT three independently multiplied payouts. Start shared round multiplier at1.0 and add local multiplier contributions. Make the additive + sign clear. Card ranks are in normal Arabic digits. Standard card stock with bold corner ranks, redhearts/diamonds and darkspades/clubs, thin physical edges.
Fixed card state throughout these studies:

The shared round CASH and MULT counter pair is in a shallow horizontal band ABOVE ALL THREE hand racks, never inside one hand's local rack. Modest label ROUND TALLY, base1.0 indicated quietly. These counters build from row effects as hands resolve, with subtle physical chip/number tokens travelling upward from a currently scoring row. This preserves the exciting local-to-global scoring process. They do not replace local histories. Keep both shared counters readable.
Top fascia retains big RUN WINNINGS with quieter CASH / ANTE / INCREASE IN. Small VIGINTI brand, no huge decorative title sign. Small upper-right sun host. Simple flat backdrop, no audience, cameras, trusses, confetti, giant trophies, taped+1 or ornamental dials.
